reviewDispositions.rationale: The worked example now describes the raw values and 10 mg/dL-bin histogram as approximately symmetric with no clear lean; the histogram and wide-bin alternatives and the clinical wrap-up use the same bounded interpretation.

The lesson now states that one visible mode does not establish one population and that multiple visible modes prompt investigation of subgroups, data-generating processes, sampling variation, and bin choice without proving a subgroup count; chart descriptions match this boundary.

The counter-case now explicitly places every observation at its 10 mg/dL bin midpoint and gives the auditable weighted sum 8,520 divided by 60, yielding the exact mean of 142 mg/dL in both prose and the chart long description.

The wrap-up no longer applies diagnostic cutoffs to adults with established diabetes. It uses five explicitly invented equal-width analytic bands with no clinical meaning, removes desirable-control language, and removes the NIDDK claim, reference, source note, and attribution entry.

The scatter explanation now says that the second coordinate adds conditional context to the 100 mg/dL value already identified as low, rather than presenting it as a point whose marginal values are both ordinary.
Both Government Analysis Function records now use issued 2022-05-19 and distinguish that publication date from the 2026-07-25 retrieval date in their version strings.
